name: register-of-directors
title: Register of directors and secretaries
for_each: select id, name from cosec.entities where status = 'active' and kind in ('company', 'public-company') order by name

sections.title: Company
sections.sql: select name as company, jurisdiction as country, company_number as number, incorporated_on, registered_office from cosec.entities where id = $1

sections.title: Current officeholders
sections.sql: select p.name, o.role, o.appointed_on, p.address as residential_address, p.lives_in as country_of_residence, p.director_id from cosec.officeholders o join cosec.parties p on p.id = o.party_id where o.entity_id = $1 and o.ceased_on is null order by o.role, p.name

sections.title: Former officeholders
sections.sql: select p.name, o.role, o.appointed_on, o.ceased_on from cosec.officeholders o join cosec.parties p on p.id = o.party_id where o.entity_id = $1 and o.ceased_on is not null order by o.ceased_on desc

name: share-register
title: Share register
for_each: select id, name from cosec.entities where status = 'active' and kind in ('company', 'public-company') order by name

sections.title: Company
sections.sql: select name as company, jurisdiction as country, company_number as number from cosec.entities where id = $1

sections.title: Shareholders
sections.note: Holdings are the sum of the movements below.
sections.sql: select h.holder, h.share_class, h.shares, h.pct_of_class as percent_of_class, p.address from cosec.holdings h join cosec.parties p on p.id = h.party_id where h.entity_id = $1 order by h.share_class, h.shares desc

sections.title: Issues, transfers, buy-backs and cancellations
sections.sql: select m.on_date, m.kind, m.quantity, m.share_class, fp.name as from_holder, tp.name as to_holder, round(m.consideration_cents / 100.0, 2) as consideration from cosec.share_movements m left join cosec.parties fp on fp.id = m.from_party_id left join cosec.parties tp on tp.id = m.to_party_id where m.entity_id = $1 and m.on_date >= current_date - interval '10 years' order by m.on_date, m.kind

name: compliance-summary
title: Company secretarial summary
for_each: select id, name from cosec.entities where status = 'active' and kind in ('company', 'public-company') order by name

sections.title: Company
sections.sql: select name as company, jurisdiction as country, company_number as number, group_name as client_group, responsible as looked_after_by from cosec.entities where id = $1

sections.title: The yearly cycle
sections.sql: select item, period, due_on, coalesce('done ' || done_on, case when due_on < current_date then 'late' else 'open' end) as status from cosec.annual_items where entity_id = $1 order by due_on

sections.title: Open items
sections.sql: select severity, item, finding from cosec.compliance_findings where entity_id = $1 order by sort_on

sections.title: Recent filings
sections.sql: select filed_on, kind, period, reference from cosec.filings where entity_id = $1 order by filed_on desc limit 10
